_note: Reveal encouragement library (item 2). Agree % picks the range. One line and one verse at random per reveal, seeded by couple + part so both partners see the same, never repeating the last pick. ESV except Amos 3:3 (NKJV). Confirm Crossway terms before public release.

lines: So much to discover in each other.
Every difference is a door to open.
The best conversations start right here.
A journey worth taking, one step at a time.

verses.text: Iron sharpens iron, and one man sharpens another.
The purpose in a man’s heart is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.
Let every person be quick to hear, slow to speak, slow to anger.

lines: Common ground, and room to grow.
Real agreement, with more to explore.

verses.text: With all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love.
Welcome one another as Christ has welcomed you, for the glory of God.

lines: Your hearts are pointing the same way.

verses.text: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their toil.
A threefold cord is not quickly broken.
And above all these put on love, which binds everything together in perfect harmony.

lines: Hand in hand on what matters.

verses.text: That their hearts may be encouraged, being knit together in love.
Being of the same mind, having the same love, being in full accord and of one mind.
May the God of endurance and encouragement grant you to live in such harmony with one another.

lines: Fully aligned, every step of the way.

verses.text: I am my beloved’s and my beloved is mine.
Where you go I will go, and where you lodge I will lodge. Your people shall be my people, and your God my God.
Many waters cannot quench love, neither can floods drown it.
